summary: Group and admin names follow your full naming convention, and held policy changes show their impact before you approve.

new.title: See a held change's impact
new.text: The approval panel compares each policy's current and new settings, marks each as tightening, loosening or neutral, and groups policies that get the same change.

new.title: More naming values are settings
new.text: Prefixes, administrative units and service names that were built in are now in Settings > Naming > Group naming values, with new variables you can use.

new.title: Easier naming page
new.text: The naming page has wider fields, dropdowns and explanations. The admin wizard offers your own admin types and environments.

fixes.title: Names use your whole pattern
fixes.text: Group names used to keep only the role part of your pattern. Every variable is now filled, and empty ones disappear cleanly. Existing groups keep their names.
fixes.action: If you saved Settings > Naming conventions on 2.4.382 to 2.4.384, check that your admin word and tenant common name are still set.

fixes.title: Clearer mails and job results
fixes.text: Held-change mails explain what happened in plain words, one mail per change. Job results and naming saves are also more reliable.
